styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Silesian museums, the Spodek and Nikiszowiec's brick lanes.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Mining heritage, WWII sites and the old industrial heart.

styles.label: Budget
styles.blurb: Cheap tickets, cheap food and a compact, walkable centre.

stays.why: Right on the main square. Walk to most sights, bars and restaurants; best for a short first visit.
The wider centre around the Rynek and station. Good transport links and a wide choice of hotels.
Quiet, green and residential, a short tram ride from the centre. Good value for longer stays.
Calm western district near parks and the Silesian Park side. Cheaper rooms; rely on trams to the centre.

food: Try Silesian classics: rolada (beef roll) with kluski dumplings and modra kapusta (red cabbage).
Order a bowl of żurek (sour rye soup) or a hearty kotlet schabowy at a milk bar (bar mleczny) for a cheap lunch.
Look for Silesian sausage and krupniok (blood sausage) at markets and casual grills.
Katowice has a strong café and craft-beer scene around the Rynek and Mariacka street; prices are lower than in Kraków.
Vegetarian and vegan spots are easy to find in the centre; check menus on the day, hours vary.
more_time: Swap a day for Nikiszowiec: a historic miners' estate with red-brick houses and a small museum, reachable by bus or tram.
Add a trip to the Silesian Park (Park Śląski) with its zoo and planetarium, a short ride west of the centre.
History fans can spend a half-day at the Auschwitz-Birkenau memorial, about 1.5 hours away by road; book a tour or check transport on the day.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the Rynek, the museums and Nikiszowiec at an easy pace, with time for a day trip.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 2°C and lows around -3°C. Pack a warm coat; about 13 rain days.
February: still cold, highs near 5°C. Short days; plan indoor museums.
March: warming to about 9°C, nights near 0°C. Mixed weather, around 11 rain days.
April: mild at about 14°C. Good for walking the centre; keep a light rain jacket.
May: pleasant, highs near 18°C and lows around 9°C. A good month for parks and outdoor sights.
June: warm at about 23°C. Long evenings suit the café and bar scene.
July: the warmest month, highs near 25°C and lows around 15°C. Around 14 rain days, so carry an umbrella.
August: warm, highs near 25°C. Busy holiday month; book hotels ahead.
September: mild at about 20°C. Comfortable for sightseeing with fewer crowds.
October: cooler at about 14°C, nights near 7°C. Around 11 rain days.
November: chilly at about 8°C. Short days; a good time for museums and food.
December: cold, highs near 4°C. Christmas markets on the Rynek; dress warmly.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate climate with cold winters and mild, wet summers. Rain falls year-round, so pack layers and an umbrella.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs of 18–25°C make walking and outdoor sights comfortable. July and August are warmest.

items.title: Cold winters (December to February)
items.text: Highs of 2–5°C and lows down to -3°C. Bring a warm coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect 10–14 rain days every month. July is the wettest at about 14 days.

items.title: Pack an umbrella
items.text: Showers are common in every season. A light waterproof layer helps in spring and autumn.

items.title: Big swings in spring and autumn
items.text: April and October can be mild by day and cool at night. Dress in layers.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, a rain jacket and warm layers for winter. Summer needs only light clothes plus something for cool evenings.

transit.best: Trams for most trips; the centre is walkable and tickets are cheap.

modes.text: No metro in Katowice. Use trams and buses instead.
ZTM Metropolia buses cover the whole metro area. Same tickets as trams: 20-min 4.60 zł, 90-min or full-route 6.60 zł, day pass 12 zł. Validate on boarding.
Trams and buses share one ZTM ticket system across the metro area. Buy at kiosks, machines or POP points; drivers sell only the 90-min ticket, cash only. Inspectors fine unvalidated tickets.
Uber and Bolt work well. Agree taxi prices beforehand or use an app.
Useful for day trips outside the metro area. In the centre, trams and walking are easier.
The centre is walkable. Metrorower yellow bikes rent via app across the region for longer hops.
